bead.title: bench-pr-A3a: per-cell execution loop + report.json composition
bead.description:
PROBLEM: With the runner front end (A2) and adapters/image (A1) in place, the runner must actually execute cells: invoke the harness adapter to produce a command-spec, compose the task-spec, invoke the task-executor, and compose a self-describing report.json per cell. Without this body the runner front end has nothing to drive. The parent A3 bead (fizeau-11e9c095 child) was too large; this child carries only the core run-and-compose path.

ROOT CAUSE:
- cmd/bench/matrix.go (2244 LOC) owns the per-cell execution loop and report composition being ported to bash. Report name/struct: cmd/bench/matrix.go:37 (matrixReportName="report.json") and cmd/bench/matrix.go:71 (FinalStatus). The sweep-level identifiers that each cell must embed are written by the front end at scripts/benchmark/benchmark:969 (write_sweep_json -> sweep.json) and copied via task_executor_version (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:932) and harbor_runner_image_digest (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:944).
- The bash run loop functions are declared but their bodies must be implemented: run_cell / budget_or_run_cell (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:138-148).

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- Per-cell loop: write cell-state.json sentinel into cell_dir at cell open; invoke harness-adapters/<name> command < profile.json -> command-spec.json; compose task-spec from command-spec + task metadata; invoke task-executors/<name> < task-spec.json which writes cell_dir/result.json; compose cell_dir/report.json embedding the profile snapshot, command (argv array), env_redacted (object), fiz.txt, fiz.err, and session/.
- Copy task_executor_version and harbor_runner_image_digest from <out>/sweep.json into each cell's report.json (do not recompute per cell).
- Delete cell-state.json on clean close (terminal report.json written).
- Cells land under bench/results/fiz-tools-v1/cells/<framework-dataset>/<task>/*/report.json.

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); adapters + image (A1); resume/skip + --retry-invalid (sibling A3b); budget accounting + halt placeholders (sibling A3c); per-cell transient retry + supersede links (sibling A3d); flock/setsid/job-pool concurrency and SIGINT/SIGTERM handling (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact: docs/helix/02-design/plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.md.

DEPENDS ON: A2 (and transitively A1). BLOCKS: A3b, A3c, A3d, A4.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent A3 AC1 and grandparent AC2):
1. ./scripts/benchmark/benchmark --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary runs the canary and produces cells under bench/results/fiz-tools-v1/cells/; each cell has report.json embedding profile, command, env_redacted, fiz.txt, fiz.err, session/, plus task_executor_version and harbor_runner_image_digest copied from sweep.json. TestRunProducesCellReports (cmd/bench/runner_a3_test.go); bats Test_run_produces_cells and Test_report_has_embedded_fields (scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats); shell driver scripts/benchmark/test_runner_loop.bash green.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test (and scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats) pass; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
